title: TAVI API — profile rank above the parent's rank (re-checked 25 Oct 2026 on a QA profile)
lines: QA profile "QA W1 Rank evidence": parent Supervisor (rank 300), own rank 100
GET /iam/profiles  -> rank is still 100   (the change was silently dropped)
POST /iam/profiles  {parent: Supervisor, rank: 600}   (same rule, on create)
-> 400 VALIDATION_ERROR "Profile rank (600) must be lower than parent profile's rank (300)."
QA profile deleted afterwards (204); no QA profiles left
